title: Clean up public current-state documentation

context.summary: Bring public documentation in line with the actual TASK-117 baseline before continuing public-ready release work.
context.background: After TASK-117, repository checks and CI are green, but public docs still mention TASK-113, old task-era wording and the previous Web UI/MVP positioning.

in: Update README and current-state public docs to describe the TASK-117+ baseline.
Remove stale TASK-113 completion claims from supported public paths.
Replace stale 'later task' and fake-compatible wording in public docs with current implementation or conformance-harness wording.
Clarify current API, CLI, MCP, runtime, local demo and known-limit status.
Update documentation validators that assert outdated public wording.
out: Publishing or changing the GitHub release state.
Changing runtime behavior or configuration defaults.

acceptance_criteria: README describes the current TASK-117+ baseline and local demo path without stale TASK-113 wording.
docs/REPOSITORY_STATUS.md describes the current baseline, known limits and public claims rule without stale TASK-113 wording.
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md no longer claims implemented repositories or processors are future work.
docs/CLI.md describes smoke and conformance providers without fake-compatible public wording.
docs/SUPPORT_MATRIX.md accurately states that Web UI is planned for the public-ready MVP but not yet implemented in the current baseline.
Public documentation validation expects current wording.
pnpm tasks:validate and pnpm check pass before merge.

manual_checks: Search public docs for stale TASK-113 completion claims.
Confirm no release publishing behavior changed in this task.

risks: Updating public wording too far ahead of TASK-119+ could imply release, Web UI or local model installer behavior that is not implemented yet.
definition_of_done: Branch is committed and merged back into master.
